identity: Ibéji IV (1997) by Pascale Jakubowski, soprano saxophone and piano
findings: Composer's official catalog identifies Ibéji IV (1997), soprano saxophone and piano, premiered February 1998 at University of Alberta by Jean-Michel Goury and Yves Josset.
Éditions Aedam Musicae's composer biography identifies a recording on Jean-Michel Goury / North-American Tours 1998-1999.
Cid-femmes' 2000 newsletter lists the score in its library and historically identifies Art & Recherches as distributor.
Retailer result mislabels an alto/accordion work Ibéji IV; composer identifies Ibéji V for that instrumentation. Do not substitute it.
